questions.question: How do you feel when you fail at something?
questions.translation: كيف تشعر عندما تفشل في شيء ما؟
suggested_answers: I feel sad and frustrated, but I try again and learn from my mistake.
I feel disappointed at first, but then I become stronger and try harder.
I feel upset when I fail, but I don't give up and I try again.

questions.question: What would you do if someone made fun of your friend?
questions.translation: ماذا ستفعل لو سخر أحدهم من صديقك؟
suggested_answers: I would defend my friend and tell the person to stop.
I would support my friend and stand up against the bully.
I would help my friend and speak to a teacher if the problem continues.

questions.question: Who is your favourite famous person? Why?
questions.translation: من هو الشخص المشهور المفضل لديك؟ لماذا؟
suggested_answers: My favourite famous person is a football player because he is talented and successful.
I admire a famous scientist because his achievements help people.
My favourite famous person is someone brave and kind who inspires me.

questions.question: What qualities make a person successful?
questions.translation: ما الصفات التي تجعل الشخص ناجحاً؟
suggested_answers: Hard work and persistence make a person successful.
A successful person is patient, determined, and never gives up.
Believing in yourself and facing challenges help you become successful.
